dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Highly falcate trailing edge with a deep concave spline fitting that originates below the apex and curves sharply towards the posterior insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute-rounded morphology with a narrow pixel radius at the highest point of the fin.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear ascent at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the visible body section.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 0.9:1 height-to-base ratio based on the visible dorsal ridge segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct V-shaped notch on the upper third of the trailing edge; multiple irregular indentations and micro-serrations along the lower trailing margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast mottled pigmentation patterns consisting of light and dark patches across the lateral flank and the lower portion of the dorsal fin.
